items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Buck Clayton and Harry Edison, you know what I‘m saying. So but I‘m a first trumpet player, so they wanted me in there anyway. So I went on the road with them for about a month till Buck Clayton got well and came back.

ctx.x: Buck Clayton had to have his tonsils out or something. So I went and stayed with the band till Buck Clayton come back. Because they asked me would I come and join the band. And I told them I‘m going to replace Buck Clayton, that ain‘t my chair. They said don‘t worry about it, come on in the band anyway. Because Buck Clayton was the soloist in that band, Buck Clayton and Harry Edison, you know what I‘m saying. So but I‘m a first trumpet player, so they wanted me in there anyway. So I went on the road with them for…
Okay. So in California you went, you worked with Lionel Hampton and Les Hite and Benny Carter as well. Did you work with Benny Carter‘s band?
